_note: Synthetic control catalogue of Sablewood Cloud Partners (fictional) for the demo. Descriptions are written in our own words; framework references are identifiers only (SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria ids, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A ids) and the mapping is illustrative.

controls.name: Quarterly access reviews
controls.description: Managers confirm every user's access to production, client tenants and finance systems each quarter; removals are tracked to closure.

controls.name: Multi-factor authentication everywhere
controls.description: Security keys or app-based MFA are enforced for every workforce account; exceptions expire after 7 days.

controls.name: Timely deprovisioning of leavers
controls.description: Sign-in is suspended within 1 hour of a leaver's termination time and delegated client access within 4 hours, following the offboarding policy; evidence is logged per step.

controls.name: Change management
controls.description: Production and client-environment changes go through peer-reviewed pull requests and automated tests before deployment.

controls.name: Incident response
controls.description: Security incidents are triaged within 1 hour, clients are notified per contract, and a post-incident review is completed within 10 business days.

controls.name: Vulnerability management
controls.description: Weekly scans of internal workloads; critical findings fixed within 7 days, high within 30 days.

controls.name: Data classification and handling
controls.description: Information is classified Public, Internal, Confidential or Client-Restricted; client data stays in client-approved systems and regions.

controls.name: Vendor risk management
controls.description: Vendors that process client or employee data complete a security questionnaire and are reviewed annually.

controls.name: Backup and recovery
controls.description: Internal systems are backed up daily; a restore test is performed twice a year.

controls.name: Security awareness training
controls.description: Every employee completes security awareness training in the first week and annually; phishing simulations run quarterly.

controls.name: Generative AI usage and guardrails
controls.description: Only approved AI tools may process Internal or higher data; outbound model calls from Sablewood agents pass a guardrail that redacts PII and blocks prompt injection and secrets.
controls.policy: Model Armor & Outbound AI Guardrail Policy

controls.name: Logging and monitoring
controls.description: Admin, access and data-access logs are retained for 400 days and alert on suspicious activity.
